description: Index one local document (same formats as distill_file) without reading it: a table of contents with line ranges, page numbers and token counts per section. Read-only: never modifies or uploads the file. Call it first for long documents, then read only what you need with distill_file using `section` or `offset`/`limit`. Line numbers refer to the converted Markdown, not to the original file. Small and unstructured documents get a single entry. Pages listed in visualPages contain charts or images that are not in the text; if the question depends on them, view the original page with distill_page_image. visualPages[].page is the physical page number (1-based position in the PDF); label is the printed page label, only present when it differs. Fails like distill_file (password_protected, needs_libreoffice, forbidden, too_large over 100 MB for documents, 2 GB for audio and video, parse_failed).

boosters.description: Lossless cleanups to apply, default all: dedupe (repeated headers and footers), media (shorter image paths and link URLs), tables (removes padding), ws (collapses whitespace). Pass a subset to keep, for example, link URLs

lingua.description: Optional LLMLingua-2 compression, lossy: it removes words. Only works when installed (see distill_capabilities); avoid it for contracts and other exact text

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the server's working directory

name: distill_outline
title: Index a document by section
